title: Identification and prognostic analysis of genes related to CTNNB1 mutations in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Zhu, Ningqi; Zhang, Guo; Shen, Xiaotian; Chen, Zule; Li, Ying; Chen, Diyu; Jia, Huliang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习构建CTNNB1突变基因签名并评估预后，但核心是肿瘤转录组与临床预后，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上机器学习可借鉴，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mutations in CTNNB1 are recognized oncogenic drivers of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); however, the downstream effector molecules and their prognostic significance remain incompletely defined. In this study, we developed a mutant CTNNB1 gene signature (MCGS) to predict CTNNB1 mutation status and to evaluate the prognostic relevance of the constituent genes. METHODS: Hydrodynamic tail vein injection mouse models of HCC were generated by co-expressing Sleeping Beauty transposon/transposase and mutant CTNNB1 with either AKT-c-Myc or AKT-NRAS(G12V), followed by RNA sequencing of tumor tissues. Cross-species differential expression analyses were performed by integrating data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and the International Cancer Genome Consortium (ICGC). Machine-learning models were trained to identify MCGS. The prognostic value of signature genes was validated using public transcriptomic datasets and immunohistochemistry on an institutional tissue microarray (TMA) cohort. RESULTS: Mutant CTNNB1 markedly accelerated hepatocarcinogenesis in mice, leading to earlier tumor development and reduced survival. Transcriptomic profiling revealed enrichment of the Hippo and MAPK signaling pathways in CTNNB1-mutant HCCs. We established a 15-gene MCGS using a Categorical Boosting algorithm, which accurately predicted CTNNB1 mutation status (AUC = 0.957 in TCGA; 0.893 in ICGC). Among these genes, metallothionein-3 (MT3) emerged as a prognostic marker, with high expression independently associated with poorer overall survival in public datasets. Consistently, elevated MT3 protein expression on the TMA was also independently associated with worse overall and recurrence-free survival in our institutional cohort. CONCLUSION: We identified a robust mutant CTNNB1 gene signature capable of accurately predicting CTNNB1 mutation status, and uncovered MT3 as a novel, clinically relevant prognostic biomarker in HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：CTNNB1突变被认为是肝细胞癌（HCC）的致癌驱动因素；然而，其下游效应分子及其预后意义尚未完全明确。在本研究中，我们开发了一种突变型CTNNB1基因特征（MCGS），以预测CTNNB1突变状态并评估组成基因的预后相关性。方法：通过共表达Sleeping Beauty转座子/转座酶及突变型CTNNB1与AKT-c-Myc或AKT-NRAS(G12V)，生成了HCC的水动力尾静脉注射小鼠模型，随后对肿瘤组织进行RNA测序。通过整合癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）和国际癌症基因组联盟（ICGC）的数据，进行了跨物种差异表达分析。训练机器学习模型以识别MCGS。使用公共转录组数据集和机构组织微阵列（TMA）队列的免疫组织化学验证了特征基因的预后价值。结果：突变型CTNNB1显著加速了小鼠的肝癌发生，导致更早的肿瘤发展和生存期缩短。转录组分析显示，CTNNB1突变型HCC中富集了Hippo和MAPK信号通路。我们使用Categorical Boosting算法建立了15基因MCGS，该特征准确预测了CTNNB1突变状态（TCGA中AUC = 0.957；ICGC中0.893）。在这些基因中，金属硫蛋白-3（MT3）作为预后标志物出现，其高表达在公共数据集中与较差的总生存期独立相关。一致地，TMA上MT3蛋白表达升高也与我们机构队列中较差的总生存期和无复发生存期独立相关。结论：我们识别出一个稳健的突变型CTNNB1基因特征，能够准确预测CTNNB1突变状态，并发现MT3是HCC中一种新的、具有临床相关性的预后生物标志物。
